Dylan / Marcus / Sara — thanks for the packet. I reviewed the W-8BEN-E and registration doc. A couple of items before Finance can clear the wire: 

- W-8BEN-E completeness: the W-8BEN-E provided has the entity checkbox left blank for Part I (chapter 3 status) and the FATCA Chapter 4 classification is not fully specified. We need a version with the entity classification checked (e.g., Corporation / Partnership) and the chapter 4 status answered so we can determine FATCA applicability.
- Certificate of tax residence: to support the treaty position (if any) we request a certificate of tax residence issued by HMRC (or equivalent) or a company tax registration showing the UK tax number.
- Beneficial owner confirmation: a short letter (signed) confirming the entity is the beneficial owner of the amounts invoiced, or completion of Section 5 on the W-8BEN-E depending on the structure.

If BlueHarbor cannot provide the above, our default is to withhold 30% under Chapter 3 until we have acceptable documentation. If we withhold, we will not issue a 1099-NEC (1099 applies to US payees); instead, payments to foreign entities are tracked and reported under 1042/1042-S if withholding is applied and reportable.

Next steps: Sara — if you can upload the completed W-8BEN-E (with Part I & FATCA sections filled), a UK tax residence certificate, and the beneficial owner confirmation to our vendor portal, Finance can queue the wire. I’ve attached our onboarding instructions (vendor_onboarding_instructions.pdf) and the vendor portal link below. Once docs are in the portal I can confirm release ETA (usually 3 business days after verification). If documents are delayed, please confirm whether BlueHarbor accepts net payment after withholding.

Portal: https://redwood.example.com/vendor-portal/onboard?ref=DEAL-4521
